 🚨 Inter comeback, two goals in stoppage time ! 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Inter Milan deliver the first comeback of the day!
 Trailing 1-0 until the 91st minute, the Nerazzurri turned the game around against Fiorentina with two stoppage-time goals.
 OneFootball Videos
 Inter 2 Fiorentina 1 Today Full time In a dramatic finale, Marcus Thuram (91') and Piotr Zieliński (97') secured all three points for the Lombardy side in this Serie A Matchday 8 clash.
 The win sends Inter provisionally top of Serie A, level with Lazio on 22 points.
